name: OmniSystem Center
author: Charles Gameti
description: Your machine in one bar widget, replacing Omarchy's Power widget: battery, charge limit (kernel, Apple, UPower, Acer) and its care, low and critical warnings with a sleep-readiness check, power profiles, keep awake and a sleep timer; an energy meter with cost, a monthly budget and CSV export; every sensor and GPU; processes with GPU use, signals and trees; listening ports by project with dev-server rules; an Omarchy plugin manager with the marketplace, pinned installs, update previews, bar layout and widget settings; gadget batteries; and lock to shutdown.

barWidget.description: Battery and power, energy and cost, sensors, processes, ports, plugins, gadgets and power actions

schema.label: Show the battery percentage
schema.description: The charge beside the icon on a battery-powered machine. omarchy-shell omnisystem-center togglePercentage switches it.

schema.label: Value beside the icon
schema.description: draw is what the whole machine uses (from the battery on battery, at the socket on AC); today and cost are today's energy and its price; watts is the power in or out of the battery. Right-click the icon to step through them. Vertical bars stay icon-only.

schema.label: GPU in the bar
schema.description: A card icon for a discrete GPU while it is awake (a sleeping one shows nothing and is never woken), a chip icon for integrated graphics.

schema.label: GPU value
schema.description: How busy the GPU is, what it draws, or both. Integrated graphics report usage only (their power is part of the CPU's).

schema.label: Dev-server count in the bar
schema.description: A port icon with the number of dev servers listening, shown even at 0, in the bar's urgent colour while any runs; click it for the Ports tab. Also switchable on the Ports tab. Checked every 20 s.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: compact is 460 px, comfortable 560 px and wide 680 px.

schema.label: Tab shown when the panel opens
schema.description: last reopens the tab you left, scrolled where you left it, with its search and filters.

schema.label: Low battery warning at (%)
schema.description: Sends Omarchy's low battery notification and runs its battery-low hooks. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Critical level (%)
schema.description: At this level the critical action below starts, after a 60 second countdown you can cancel. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: At the critical level
schema.description: hibernate falls back to suspend when hibernation is not set up (omarchy-hibernation-setup); none only warns.

schema.label: Switch to power saver at (%)
schema.description: On battery at this level the power saver profile goes on, and the previous profile comes back once you charge. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Profile per power source
schema.description: When you plug in or unplug, the profile remembered for that source is applied. Left to Omarchy's own battery service while that is on.

schema.label: Gadget low battery at (%)
schema.description: A notification when a mouse, keyboard, headset or earbud drops to this level. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Tell me when a gadget is charged
schema.description: Once per charge, when a charging gadget reaches 100%.

schema.label: External gadget file
schema.description: A JSON file other tools write gadget levels to. Empty uses ~/.cache/omarchy-accessories/external.json.

schema.label: Gadget names
schema.description: Rename gadgets: {"Reported name": "Your name"}. The panel can also do this.

schema.label: Show the System tab
schema.description: CPU, memory, temperature and power graphs, sampled only while the tab is open.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Charged-to-limit, unplug reminders, heat protection, sleep timer and calibration notes. Low and critical battery warnings are always sent.

schema.label: Energy meter
schema.description: Records what the machine uses and costs, per day, week, month and year, while the shell runs. The Energy tab and the draw beside the icon need it.

schema.label: Highlight the icon at (W)
schema.description: The icon turns urgent while the machine draws this much or more. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Show the Processes tab
schema.description: Every process with CPU, memory, user and command; end, kill, pause or lower its priority. Sampled only while the tab is open.

schema.label: Show the Ports tab
schema.description: What listens on this machine, by project, and how far it reaches; open, copy or stop it.

schema.label: Warn about exposed dev servers
schema.description: A notification when a dev server of yours becomes reachable from the network (checked once a minute).

schema.label: Show the Plugins tab
schema.description: Installed Omarchy plugins (on, off, update, remove) and the marketplace (search, install).

schema.label: Also dev ports
schema.description: Ports or ranges that always count as dev servers when yours, e.g. 33000-34000, 8787.

schema.label: Always dev programs
schema.description: Program names (as the Ports tab shows them) that count as dev servers on any port. The dev button on a port row adds to this.

schema.label: Never dev programs
schema.description: Program names that never count as dev servers, whatever the guess. The dev button on a port row adds to this.
